_note: How hunters, bots and remote players use the stairs, ladders and drops of the continuous levels (hunters/flight_edges.rs). ladder_speed_scale multiplies the climb speed of a ladder (vertical.rs LADDER_CLIMB_SPEED, m/s). drop_allowed lets a hunter jump down a drop (waterfall or hole); one way, off by default. drop_fall_speed is the speed of that fall in m/s. edge_cost_scale (at least 1) multiplies the path cost of a flight, a ladder or a drop. reference_speed is the hunter walk speed in m/s that turns a ladder climb time into a path cost. hear_adjacent_scale is the factor on a sound's radius when it is one storey away (0 = not heard). see_adjacent lets a hunter see a target one storey away through an open well. capture_height is the largest height difference in metres at which a hunter captures. same_layer_eps (0.1 to 2.0) is the largest height difference in metres at which two hunters count as standing at the same height (the director's pairing). edge_enter_radius is how close in metres a hunter must be to the entrance of an edge to start walking it. edge_fit_radius is the body radius in metres of the footprint test while walking an edge (the runner's radius, because the routes of the flights are validated for it; the wider hunter body would stall at the tight turn of a mid landing). edge_stuck_seconds is how long a hunter or bot may fail to progress on an edge before it replans. resident_hunter_cap is how many hunters a resident floor beside the active one simulates. search_expansions is the most cells one cross-level path search may expand before it gives up (an empty route). goal_snap_radius is how many cells a goal that stands on a closed cell (a stair tread) moves to the nearest open one. cross_repath_seconds is how often a walker that is crossing levels re-plans its route. follow_cross_seconds is how long a hunter keeps following a target that left its level before it gives up. wander_cross_chance and search_cross_chance (0 to 1) are the chances that a wandering or a searching hunter picks a goal on another level.
